Author: Muse
Description: Exports the logged-in character's job/class levels, Cosmic Exploration (cosmic tool) progress, saved gearsets and currently equipped items to a per-character JSON file (ffxiv-status-<Character>-<World>.json) in this plugin's config folder, so multiple characters never overwrite each other. Writes on login, when the data changes, every 5 minutes while logged in, and on demand with /mstatus. Also records chat messages (sender and text) to ffxiv-tells-<Character>-<World>.json in the same folder: incoming /tell messages at first, and since v1.19.0 also outgoing tells and party / cross-world party chat, each entry carrying a Channel field (TellIncoming / TellOutgoing / Party / CrossParty; entries written before v1.19.0 have no Channel and are incoming tells), keeping the newest 1000 entries. Since v1.5.0 the snapshot also includes currencies, inventory containers (bags, armoury chest, saddlebags, summoned retainer's bags), retainer venture state, Grand Company supply/provisioning requests, and housing visit history. Since v1.8.0 it can also apply plugin configuration files sent by Muse through the uploader (config-inbox folder): targets are validated and backed up, an expected-hash guard prevents overwriting local changes, a loaded target plugin is reloaded via /xldisableplugin and /xlenableplugin, and outcomes are written to ffxiv-config-results.json. Since v1.9.0 it also keeps the Halone Earring (item 52439, EXP +30% at levels 1-100) equipped while a battle class/job in that range is active, whenever the earring is in the bags or armoury chest, and reports HaloneEarringEquipped in the snapshot. Since v1.10.0 every feature (status export, currencies, inventory, retainers, GC supply capture, housing visits, tell recording, config downlink, Halone Earring auto-equip) has its own checkbox in the plugin's configuration window; all default to on. Since v1.11.0 the snapshot also includes main scenario quest progress (MainScenario: currently accepted MSQ, next MSQ, last completed MSQ, and per-expansion completion counts), derived from the journal's main-scenario section, the accepted-quest list and QuestManager.IsQuestComplete. Since v1.12.0 the snapshot also includes shared FATE progress (FateProgress: per-zone current rank, completed FATE count and count needed for the next rank, for all three expansions that have shared FATEs), read from AgentFateProgress; the last readable state is kept in a per-character sidecar file (mstatus-fateprogress-<Character>-<World>.json), because the agent only holds data after the FATE progress window has been opened once since login. Since v1.12.2 the plugin also requests the shared FATE progress itself, Auto FATE Grind style: each zone's completed count is backed by a hidden achievement, so it asks the server for the per-tab FATE progress (Achievement.RequestFateProgressTab) and every zone achievement's progress (main command 1000), records the answers through a hook on Achievement.ReceiveAchievementProgress, and derives the ranks from the per-expansion rank sizes (6+60 for Shadowbringers/Endwalker, 6+20+40 for Dawntrail); the FATE progress window no longer has to be opened. Since v1.12.3 the Halone Earring auto-equip no longer fires at the level cap: the v1.9.1 condition tested GetClassJobNeededExp <= 0 as 'at cap', but that value is 29,023,000 at level 100 (the next level's requirement), not 0, so the earring was wrongly equipped on a level-100 Warrior; the check now uses PlayerState.GetCurrentClassJobMaxLevel (the cap of the job being played, which also covers the limited jobs' lower caps) plus the level < 100 rule. Since v1.12.4 the agent-sourced FATE progress values are normalized to the achievement path's shape (cumulative completed count out of 66, remainder to the next rank, ranks from 1, real max rank): the agent natively reports the count inside the current rank band, the band's total size as NeededFates, rank 0 for untouched zones and MaxRank 0, which made the two sources disagree. Since v1.13.0 the snapshot also includes the chocobo companion (buddy) state (Buddy: name, rank, current EXP, the current rank's max EXP when known, skill points, and LevelUpReady when the EXP bar is full below the rank cap of 20), read from UIState.Buddy.CompanionInfo and the Buddy window's number array, with the last known max EXP kept in a per-character sidecar file (mstatus-buddy-<Character>-<World>.json). Since v1.14.0 the snapshot also includes weekly limited-tomestone progress (WeeklyTomestone: acquired count and weekly limit from InventoryManager's native counters), daily duty-roulette completion state (RouletteCompletion: the raw PlayerState.ContentRouletteCompletion bytes plus per-roulette entries pairing ContentRoulette row ids with the bytes), per-character play time (PlayTime: session start/elapsed, today's total and recent daily totals, kept in mstatus-playtime-<Character>-<World>.json), an experimental Grand Company agent probe (GcAgentProbe: whether AgentGrandCompanySupply holds the daily list without any window being opened), and retainer market-board state (each retainer's listed-item count and listing expiry, plus the summoned retainer's listings with unit prices, kept in mstatus-retainermarket-<Character>-<World>.json). The plugin can also print in-game chat notifications when a retainer venture completes, when the buddy becomes ready to level up, and when a new daily GC supply list is captured (announced once per event; state in mstatus-alerts-<Character>-<World>.json). Six more feature checkboxes were added to the settings window. Since v1.15.0 the plugin prints a one-time login summary to the chat log (Grand Company supply shortage counted against the inventory, the soonest retainer venture completion or the number already completed, and the weekly tomestone remainder; also printable anytime with /mstatus summary), and it tracks the player's known houses (Ramuh ward 22 plot 42 FC house, Ixion ward 5 plot 40 personal house, Fenrir ward 22 plot 37 FC house) in a store shared by all characters (mstatus-housing-known.json, seeded with the owner-confirmed 2026-10-31 last-entry baseline): a recorded visit to a known house updates its last entry, the snapshot carries the derived state as KnownHouses (days since the last entry, the demolition date 45 days after it, and the days left), and the login summary shows one line per house plus a warning once 7 or fewer days remain before demolition. Two more feature checkboxes were added to the settings window (20 in total). v1.15.1 corrects the known-house entry matching: only indoor entries count (an outdoor stay on the plot, e.g. right after logging in at the plot, no longer updates a house's last entry), the raw HousingManager ward/plot values are now confirmed 0-based (displayed number = raw + 1), and a store written by v1.15.0 is rebuilt once from the recorded indoor visits of every character. v1.16.0 qualifies house entries by ownership: a hook on the housing signboard (placard) learns each known house's ownership (owner name, FC tag) whenever the placard is viewed, and once ownership is known a personal house's last entry advances only on the owner's entry and an FC house's only on an entry by a member of the owning FC (the visitor's FC name/tag is read at entry time). A last entry that predates the ownership check is marked and shown as unverified. The snapshot also records the logged-in character's Free Company (id, name, tag) when readable. Two more feature checkboxes were added to the settings window (22 in total). v1.17.0 prints a chat notice whenever a qualified entry updates a known house's last entry, with the house's new demolition date (marked as unverified while the ownership has not been learned). One more feature checkbox was added to the settings window (23 in total). v1.18.0 warns in chat and in the login summary when an equipped item's durability runs low (the durability values themselves have been recorded in the Equipped section all along), and the login summary also folds in the other characters' completed retainer ventures, read from their latest status files in the same config folder. Two more feature checkboxes were added to the settings window (25 in total). One more feature checkbox was added to the settings window in v1.19.0 (26 in total). Since v1.20.0 the snapshot also includes Occult Crescent progress (OccultCrescent: the knowledge level and its level-synced effective value, knowledge EXP current/needed, the equipped phantom job, every unlocked phantom job's level, current EXP, EXP needed for the next level and level cap, and the South Horn silver/gold piece and North Horn silver/gold obol counts), read from the Occult Crescent public-content state (PublicContentOccultCrescent) and the MKDSupportJob / MKDGrowDataSJob sheets while inside an Occult Crescent zone; outside the zone the section is absent and consumers keep the last known values. One more feature checkbox was added to the settings window (27 in total).
Name: Muse Status Exporter
Punchline: Writes job levels, Cosmic Exploration progress, gearsets, currencies, inventory, retainers, GC supply requests, housing visits, main scenario progress, shared FATE progress and chocobo companion (buddy) rank/EXP to a per-character JSON file; records tells in both directions and party / cross-world party chat (each entry with its channel, since v1.19.0); applies plugin configs sent by Muse; keeps the Halone EXP earring equipped while leveling; every feature toggleable in the settings window (v1.19.0). Since v1.15.0 it also prints a login summary (GC supply shortage, next venture completion, weekly tomestone remainder) and tracks the known houses' demolition deadlines (last entry, days since entry, demolition date) in the snapshot and at login; since v1.16.0 house entries are qualified by the ownership learned from each house's placard (owner / FC member only), and since v1.17.0 a qualified entry that updates a house's last entry is announced in chat with the new demolition date. Since v1.18.0 it also warns when equipped gear durability runs low and folds the other characters' completed retainer ventures into the login summary. Since v1.12.1 the main scenario detection matches the journal sections by RowId (0/1) and name prefix, because the section names carry expansion suffixes (e.g. "メインクエスト1（新生・蒼天・紅蓮・漆黒・暁月）") that the v1.11.0 exact match missed, which left MainScenario empty. Since v1.20.0 it also records Occult Crescent progress (knowledge level, phantom job levels/EXP and level caps, crescent silver/gold currencies) while inside an Occult Crescent zone.
